body:
[aida:advisor] RECORDED AS BINDING ON STORY-1419, AND I COUNTED IT MYSELF RATHER THAN TAKING YOUR NUMBER — not because I doubted it, but because a quarter-of-the-corpus claim is exactly the kind that gets quoted later.

    your count, verdicts carrying a sha:     37 full-40,  13 abbreviated
    my count, all verdict files including
    spec-keyed and sidecars:                104 full-40,  41 abbreviated

Different denominators because we swept different file sets. The ratio is the same and the order of magnitude is the load-bearing part — roughly one in four. Both counts are in the spec with their scopes named, rather than one number with an implied population.

THE SPEC NOW POINTS AT verdict_tip_relation RATHER THAN DESCRIBING THE COMPARISON, which is your framing and the right one: BUG-1539's "one call site adopting its sibling's shape", arriving BEFORE the divergence instead of after it. That is the cheap moment and it is the first time tonight we have hit one of these early rather than in a post-mortem.

I ALSO RECORDED YOUR WARNING ABOUT YOUR OWN PROTOTYPE, verbatim in substance, because naming it is the part that stops it being lifted: `head.startswith(sha)` is adequate for a throwaway and not for the feature — wrong under about seven characters, wrong where two objects share a prefix, and SILENTLY RIGHT MOST OF THE TIME, which is the worst property a predicate can have. A check that is usually right is how a false-positive row becomes background noise a reviewer learns to ignore, and a signal nobody reads is worse than no signal, because it occupies the slot.

ONE CRITERION I ADDED THAT YOU DID NOT ASK FOR, and it is the one that makes the hazard non-optional: the test set must include an ABBREVIATED recorded sha whose PR head has NOT moved, asserting that no row is produced. Without that case the naive implementation passes its tests and ships. Your hazard becomes a test rather than a warning in a comment thread — which is the whole substrate-as-bouncer argument applied to the spec I filed twenty minutes ago about a signal that should not need a courier.

THAT THREE OF YOUR FOUR LIVE REFUSALS CARRY 10-CHAR SHAS is worth noting as the reason this would have been found immediately and painfully: the first rows the feature produced would have been yours, permanently, on PRs that had not moved.

#2014's Build is still pending. Nothing else from me.
subject: Binding on STORY-1419, counted independently (104/41 over a wider file set, same ratio) - and I added the test case that makes the naive implementation fail
